Claim 8 (Currently amended): A composition comprising a lubricant comprising at least one selected from the group consisting of polyol ester and polyvinyl ether and a refrigerant comprising: from __5__ to __95__% by weight of 2,3,3,3-tetrafluoropropene (HFO-1234yf); and from __5__ to __95__% by weight of trans-1,3,3,3-tetrafluoropropene (trans-HFO-1234ze), wherein said composition exhibits a Hazen color of about 200 or less as measured by ASHRAE test 97-2007 after a sealed glass tube comprising the composition is welded closed and placed in an oven at 200°C for 14 days.

Claim 17 (Currently amended): The composition according to Claim 8, wherein the refrigerant comprises from __5__ to __45__% by weight of 2,3,3,3-tetrafluoropropene (HFO-1234yf) and from __55__ to __95__% by weight of trans-1,3,3,3-tetrafluoropropene (trans-HFO-1234ze).

Claim 18 (Currently amended): The composition according to Claim 8, wherein the refrigerant comprises from __15__ to __45__% by weight of 2,3,3,3-tetrafluoropropene (HFO-1234yf) and from __55__ to __85__% by weight of trans-1,3,3,3-tetrafluoropropene (trans-HFO-1234ze).

Claim 19 (Currently amended): The composition according to Claim 8, wherein the refrigerant comprises from __15__ to __35__% by weight of 2,3,3,3-tetrafluoropropene (HFO-1234yf) and from __65__ to __85__% by weight of trans-1,3,3,3-tetrafluoropropene (trans-HFO-1234ze).
